feature-flags.g: Platform toggles, global or per tenant
feature-flags.w: Every switch the platform honours — self-signup, coupons, WhatsApp alerts, the live demo, beta screens — declared in config/feature-flags.json with a default. The Global column overrides the default for everyone; a tenant column overrides it for that tenant alone.
s: Add the key to config/feature-flags.json first — an undeclared key is always off.
Flip Global to change the platform default.
Flip a tenant's cell to give that tenant its own setting; ↺ removes the override.
feature-flags.tip: A tenant cell marked 'inherits' has no row of its own — it shows what Global resolves to.
